title: Linus Torvalds - Nvidia F_ck You!
summary: A two-minute clip of Linus Torvalds at an Aalto University talk telling Nvidia "F_ck you" over its poor Linux support. It is an excerpt of a longer talk.
why: HN cites it as shorthand for the long-running frustration of the Linux community with Nvidia's drivers, often as a joke or background.

quote.text: See things like this infamous clip from Torvalds[0] for more context on the community sentiment around nvidia in general.
